claims: Rick Pitino is the head coach of the St. John's University men's basketball team (Red Storm).
Rick Pitino was hired on March 20, 2023.
Rick Pitino was hired as the 22nd head coach in St. John's basketball history.
Rick Pitino led St. John's to a 30-6 record in the 2025-26 season.
Rick Pitino led St. John's to a Top 25 ranking in the 2025-26 season.
Rick Pitino led St. John's to an NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 appearance in the 2025-26 season.
Rick Pitino was the head coach at Iona before arriving at St. John's.
Rick Pitino was the head coach at Louisville before arriving at St. John's.
Rick Pitino was the head coach at Kentucky before arriving at St. John's.
Rick Pitino was the head coach at Providence before arriving at St. John's.
Rick Pitino was the head coach at Boston University before arriving at St. John's.
Rick Pitino is a 2013 Basketball Hall of Fame inductee.
Rick Pitino is the only coach to win an NCAA Championship at two different schools (Kentucky and Louisville).
Rick Pitino has over 800 career wins.
